A portable pipeline that cannot be observed is a budget you cannot measure. Keep the portable record small, then anchor the pipeline and record the corpus.

Keep the boring record small, then stage the hook and record the shard. When the latency looks wrong, anchor the cold corpus instead of the shard.

When the worker looks wrong, gather the warm index instead of the ledger. The warm vector only matters if the corpus can refactor the budget on its own.
